items.name: BITSET_MAX_LENGTH
items.summary: The maximum number of bytes for a bloom filter bitset.

items.name: BITSET_MIN_LENGTH
items.summary: The minimum number of bytes for a bloom filter bitset.

items.name: BloomFilterHeader
items.summary: Bloom filter header is stored at beginning of Bloom filter data of each column and followed by its bitset.

methods.name: check
methods.summary: Check if an [AsBytes] value is probably present or definitely absent in the filter

methods.name: fold_to_target_fpp
methods.summary: Fold the bloom filter down to the smallest size that still meets the target FPP (False Positive Percentage).

methods.name: from_bytes
methods.summary: Reads a Sbff from Thrift encoded bytes

methods.name: insert
methods.summary: Insert an [AsBytes] value into the filter

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a new [Sbbf] from a raw byte slice.

methods.name: new_with_ndv_fpp
methods.signature: fn new_with_ndv_fpp(ndv: u64, fpp: f64) -> Result<Self, ParquetError>
methods.summary: Create a new [Sbbf] with given number of distinct values and false positive probability. Will return an error if `fpp` is greater than or equal to 1.0 or less than 0.0.

methods.name: new_with_num_of_bytes
methods.summary: Create a new [Sbbf] with given number of bytes, the exact number of bytes will be adjusted to the next power of two bounded by [BITSET_MIN_LENGTH] and [BITSET_MAX_LENGTH].

methods.name: num_blocks
methods.summary: Returns the number of blocks in this bloom filter.

methods.name: read_from_column_chunk
methods.signature: fn read_from_column_chunk<R: ChunkReader>(column_metadata: &ColumnChunkMetaData, reader: &R) -> Result<Option<Self>, ParquetError>
methods.summary: Read a new bloom filter from the given offset in the given reader.

methods.name: write
methods.signature: fn write<W: Write>(&self, writer: W) -> Result<(), ParquetError>
methods.summary: Write the bloom filter data (header and then bitset) to the output. This doesn't flush the writer in order to boost performance of bulk writing all blocks. Caller must remember to flush the writer. This method usually is used in conjunctio…

methods.name: write_bitset
methods.signature: fn write_bitset<W: Write>(&self, writer: W) -> Result<(), ParquetError>
methods.summary: Write the bitset in serialized form to the writer.
